title: [Bug]: Ollama Client failing
body:
### Describe the bug

Passing in the response_format to the OllamaClient is causing it to fail. This means we can't use Ollama.

```
from autogen import ConversableAgent

llm_config = {"model": "gemma3:12b", "api_type": "ollama", "client_host": "http://host.docker.internal:11434", "cache_seed": None}

ollama_agent = ConversableAgent(
    name="ollama_agent",
    llm_config=llm_config,
    system_message="You are a helpful AI assistant.",
)

human = ConversableAgent(
    name="human",
    human_input_mode="ALWAYS",
)

result = human.initiate_chat(
    recipient=ollama_agent,
    message="Give me a sentence about AI.",
)
```
Error:
```
  File "/app/ag2/autogen/oai/client.py", line 884, in _register_default_client
    client = OllamaClient(response_format=response_format, **openai_config)
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
TypeError: OllamaClient.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'response_format'
```

I believe it's because there are no **kwargs on the __init__ in OllamaClient:
```
def __init__(self):
```

`test_ollama.py` doesn't have any tests of OllamaClient with parameters.

This aligns with the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" sub-category under "Incompatibility with LLM providers."
